description: Separate basemap PNG tile pyramids rendered through QGIS and QMetaTiles from style-specific caches of published Mapbox styles. Thematic layers were excluded from both basemap exports.

styles.exporter: QMetaTiles 1.5, QGIS XYZ provider reading authenticated style-specific source cache

validation.zxy_coverage: complete for the stated extent and zoom range
validation.source_alignment: Every rendered tile compared against the authentic source PNG at the identical z/x/y; allowed mean absolute RGB error <=8/255 for QGIS raster-edge resampling. A z8 sample was visually reviewed for geographic and label alignment. Guided z12/654/1436 mean 8.04924 is an explicitly reviewed exception: Tacoma roads and labels align; differences occur at dense line edges.

styles.exporter: QMetaTiles 1.5, QGIS XYZ provider reading authenticated style-specific source cache

validation.zxy_coverage: complete for the stated extent and zoom range
validation.source_alignment: Every rendered tile compared against the authentic source PNG at the identical z/x/y; allowed mean absolute RGB error <=8/255 for QGIS raster-edge resampling. A z8 sample and every tile exceeding the default threshold were visually compared with their source. Specific reviewed exceptions are marked in output_tiles: guided Tacoma and independent Capitol Hill/downtown street grids and labels align; differences occur at dense line edges.
